description: Infraestructura de regadío de Canarias is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idecan2.grafcan.es. Information, prepared by the Directorate-General for Agriculture, which includes public and private infrastructure that has been financed in whole or in part by the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Water in recent years. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Irrigation infrastructure of the Canary Islands" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
